resolved_or_reduced: OS NGD Change Only Updates can legitimately be blank when no features changed or when a feature type update frequency does not align with the selected COU frequency
Parent feature processing requires the persistent identifier version date availability dates and change type while child related components have no geometry and no change type
Child related components must join to the parent using its identifier and exact featuretypeversiondate rather than identifier alone
OS NGD schema versions are managed per feature type and can be Latest Maintenance or End Of Life
Minor schema increments replace the previous minor version while major increments can leave older versions in maintenance
Annual Full Supply represents the 1 January snapshot and a feature type or schema launched later in the year can validly produce an empty package until the following January
Non-Addressable Object is a live address lifecycle feature for objects such as ponds parks and telephone boxes that are not expected to receive mail or deliveries
A live UPRN therefore does not by itself prove a broadband-benefiting postal premises
Historic Address represents an address no longer in existence after demolition merging or splitting and must not be counted as a current serviceable premises
Title Number and UPRN Look Up contains only relationships HMLR can establish between LRPG title addresses and AddressBase UPRNs
Duplicate LRPG addresses can produce a title-only record and a separate UPRN-only record and some AddressBase addresses can have no title association
Where one title affects many properties all affecting UPRNs may be associated so title-to-UPRN cardinality is not necessarily one-to-one
HMLR imports AddressBase change-only data every six weeks and the monthly publication exposes only the latest state reached during that cycle
Title-UPRN delivery provides Full and Validation files but no Change Only Update file
National Polygon and Title Descriptor provide Full COU and Validation files and must be paired with Title-UPRN by publication month before joining
Ofcom Spring 2026 reports fixed broadband availability separately from full-fibre take-up
Availability does not prove subscription or measured router performance and home broadband performance is measured in a separate monitoring dataset
